streamers.title: Streamers
streamers.description: Twitch channel logins or channel URLs (e.g. `caseoh_` or `https://www.twitch.tv/caseoh_`). One entry per streamer.

period.title: Time window
period.description: How far back to look for clips.

maxClipsPerStreamer.title: Max clips per streamer
maxClipsPerStreamer.description: Up to 100 clips per streamer per run (Twitch page limit for anonymous access).

minDurationSeconds.title: Min clip duration (s)
minDurationSeconds.description: Skip clips shorter than this. 0 = no minimum.

maxDurationSeconds.title: Max clip duration (s)
maxDurationSeconds.description: Skip clips longer than this. 0 = no maximum.

minViews.title: Min view count
minViews.description: Skip clips with fewer views than this. 0 = no minimum.
